method.stem: Widest horizontal ink run on the scanline at a fixed fraction of the glyph’s own height, rasterised at 1000 px per em (FreeType via Pillow); probes: Latin l, Hebrew vav, Greek iota, Arabic alef, Han 丨, Hangul ㅣ.
method.density: Filled outline area of the HarfBuzz-shaped sample divided by total advance × em, in ‰ of an em square. Marks count as ink; counters are subtracted.
method.heights: Glyph bounding boxes from the outlines, scaled to 1000 units per em. Overshoot is included, so round letters read about ten units above the nominal line.
method.faces: Variable fonts are instanced at wght 400 and 700 with fontTools; static families use their Regular and Bold files. Measurements come from the full instanced font; the served WOFF2 files are subsets.
method.subsets: Hebrew, Greek and Arabic files keep their whole script blocks plus presentation forms and bidi controls; cuneiform and CJK files contain only the proof passages, so they are not production fonts.
